ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Asinu uses the microphone only when you choose voice input, such as turning a spoken health reading into a health log or chat message. The app does not record in the background.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Asinu uses your location to send an emergency SOS alert.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Asinu uses the camera only when you scan a QR code to connect with a family member.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Asinu needs photo library access when you choose to update your profile picture.
